components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Chakra blue solid, default medium size. Static preview of the implemented recipe.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-primary:hover { background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.9); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Blue outline action; the workspace toolbar uses the smaller recipe size.
components.css: .ds-outline { background: transparent; color: #173da6; border: 1px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-outline:hover { background: #dbeafe; } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet blue secondary action with a subtle hover surface.
components.css: .ds-ghost { background: transparent; color: #173da6; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: #dbeafe; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Plain Button
components.description: Muted change-email action without a recipe hover fill.
components.css: .ds-plain { background: transparent; color: #52525b; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-plain:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-plain:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-plain:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: Medium outline input with a persistent label and Chakra-style inside focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #18181b; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-width: 0; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 4px; color: #18181b; background: transparent; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #e4e4e7; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #3b82f6; outline: 1px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 0; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Dark rail with a translucent selected item and native current-page semantics.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Workspace preview"><button class="ds-nav-button" type="button" aria-current="page">Flows</button><button class="ds-nav-button" type="button">Comments</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 216px; padding: 12px; background: #0c142e; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-button { text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-nav-button[aria-current=page] { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-button:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); } .ds-nav-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Persona Badge
components.description: Noninteractive blue persona label with the default small badge recipe.
components.css: .ds-persona { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; background: #dbeafe; color: #173da6; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; font: 500 12px/16px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Access Card
components.description: Flat white form surface; padding rises from 20px to 28px at the medium breakpoint.
components.html:
Check your email

Enter the six-digit code sent to you.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #18181b; padding: 20px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-heading { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #52525b; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-card { padding: 28px; } }

components.name: Selected Flow
components.description: Multiline selected flow row with its persona and latest version; text-only preview.
components.css: .ds-flow { display: grid; width: 240px; text-align: left; white-space: normal; padding: 16px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: #eff6ff; color: #18181b; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-flow:hover { background: #dbeafe; } .ds-flow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-flow-title { font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-flow-persona { margin-top: 4px; color: #52525b; font-size: 12px; } .ds-flow-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; color: #52525b; font-size: 12px; } .ds-flow-version { border-radius: 4px; min-height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; background: #f4f4f5; color: #27272a; font-size: 12px; line-height: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
RevisionLab places captured prototype screens on quiet paper surfaces, framed by dark tools and restrained blue interactions. The inherited visual world is practical and compact: readable context, clear selection, and feedback kept close to its screen. Red belongs to the small identity mark and explicit error states.

The embedded review UI has one light appearance, independent of the host application's color mode. Its Chakra reset and tokens are scoped to `data-revisionlab-ui`, including portalled overlays, so installing the review tools does not restyle the prototype.
keyCharacteristics: White panels and a pale canvas separated by thin boundaries.
Navy navigation, blue actions and selections, restrained red identity.
Compact system typography with explicit persona, version, and status labels.
Captured screens provide the imagery; interface decoration stays secondary.

rules.name: The Host Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep review colors and resets inside the embedded UI; the host prototype owns its own visual system.

dos: Do compose UI with Chakra v3 primitives, recipes, semantic elements, and inline token-aware style props.
Do preserve the light scoped provider, including the scope on portalled overlays.
Do keep screen, persona, version, and feedback context readable through responsive wrapping and clear labels.
Do retain visible focus, field associations, named controls, and explicit loading, empty, success, and error states.
donts: Don't apply the review system's reset, colors, or typography to host prototype content.
Don't replace captured screens with decorative imagery or imply that roadmap controls are implemented.
Don't introduce component CSS classes, custom properties, raw color literals, or an additional styling library into application components.
Don't treat the sidecar's static HTML/CSS previews as production component implementations.
